purpose.zh: 在单手支撑下练转体，是托马斯转体的雏形
purpose.en: Train trunk rotation on one hand, a first step toward flares.

text.zh: 单手撑地，腿从身体下方穿过去
text.en: Support on one hand and thread your leg under your body

text.zh: 从四足悬膝位起，膝盖离地
text.en: Start in a bear position with your knees hovering.

text.zh: 转体时支撑手推地，髋不要落地
text.en: Push the floor with the support hand as you turn and keep your hips up.

cautions.zh: 先做2–3分钟手腕热身；腕部刺痛或麻木立即停止
cautions.en: Warm up your wrists for 2–3 minutes first; stop right away if they feel sharp pain or numbness.
